elytra_tweaks.configuration.title: Elytra Tweaks Settings
elytra_tweaks.configuration.deployKeyMod: Toggle: press to open the elytra, press again to close it. Hold: the elytra stays open only while the key is held.
elytra_tweaks.configuration.jumpDeploy.t: Whether the vanilla jump key can still open the elytra while falling.
elytra_tweaks.configuration.safetyNet.to: Folds the wings when the elytra opens in a way the Jump Key Deploy setting doesn't allow (for example through another mod). Turning it off removes the one-frame flicker some modpacks show, but those deploys are then no longer stopped.
elytra_tweaks.configuration.windVolume.t: Volume of the wind sound while gliding. 0 mutes it, 100 is vanilla.
